findings.evidence: `Convergence.lean:11` has `public import TauCeti.Probability.Martingale.Crossings.AntitoneLimit`; `AntitoneLimit.lean:4` has `public import TauCeti.MeasureTheory.Function.AEStronglyMeasurable`; the helper declarations are public at `AEStronglyMeasurable.lean:40` and `AEStronglyMeasurable.lean:92`.
findings.fix: Make this a non-public `import` if the lemmas are only used in the proof, or otherwise avoid re-exporting the helper module from the `Convergence` entry point.
findings.issue: `AntitoneLimit` publicly imports `TauCeti.MeasureTheory.Function.AEStronglyMeasurable`, so downstream users importing `TauCeti.Probability.Martingale.Convergence` also get the proof-only lemmas `TauCeti.MeasureTheory.aestronglyMeasurable_iInf_antitone` and `aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae'` as part of this martingale theorem surface.

summary: The main crossing/reversal helpers are no longer re-exported through the stated entry point, but `Martingale.Convergence` still leaks proof-only measurability helpers through a public import chain.
